messages:
sarah: FYI, after the RBAC flattening roll we pushed last night, several gpu-namespace deploys started failing with 403s when the controller tries to mount KMS-wrapped secrets. audit logs also don't show impersonation events for the deploy controller SA :eyes:

devon: ugh. can you paste a failing error?

sarah: logs from the deploy controller:``` 
403 Forbidden: user=system:serviceaccount:gpu-namespace:deploy-controller cannot get resource=secrets namespace=gpu-namespace
E0428 02:10:12 1 pod_controller.go:123] failed to create pod for rollout: forbidden
```

morgan: quick check: run `kubectl auth can-i get secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:gpu-namespace:deploy-controller -n gpu-namespace` and also `kubectl get rolebindings -n gpu-namespace -o yaml | grep deploy-controller -C3`

anil: opsbot alert showed a surge of 403s and then the audit pipeline dropped impersonate events (we only saw `create` for pods, no `impersonate` entries). looks like the aggregation rule that provided `impersonate` rights to the deploy-controller SA got pruned in the refactor.

sarah: ran the can-i — it returns "no". rolebindings list shows the namespace Role for deploy-controller present, but clusterrole binding that used to grant `impersonate` is missing.

morgan: here's the aggregated ClusterRole we removed in the refactor:``` 
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: infra-deployer-agg
aggregationRule:
  clusterRoleSelectors:
  - matchLabels:
      rbac.redwood/role: infra-deployer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods", "secrets"]
  verbs: ["get", "create"]
```

morgan: the issue is the new selector rules didn't match the old labels, so the implicit impersonate grant never materialized.

anil: short-term mitigation: create a namespace-scoped RoleBinding to explicitly allow the deploy-controller SA to `get` secrets and `impersonate` the serviceaccount if needed. longer-term: fix aggregation selectors and add unit test in infra-rbac CI to catch missing clusterrole aggregation.

devon: agree. can we avoid granting broad `impersonate` cluster-wide? for temp patch do a namespaced role with minimal verbs: `get secrets`, `create pods`, `impersonate serviceaccounts` limited to `gpu-namespace`.

sarah: patch applied to `gpu-namespace` rolebinding. deploys resumed for two customers. still want to capture missing audit events — the audit webhook config maybe filtered `impersonate` after the refactor change.

opsbot: [ALERT] 3331230055 failed-deploys x 18 in gpu-namespace; first observed 2024-04-28T02:09:10Z

anil: opened a ticket to re-enable audit policy lines for `impersonate` and `serviceaccounts` on the cluster-level policy. also kicking off a KMS decrypt log check with the infra telemetry team — if decrypts were failing we should see KMS deny metrics.

sarah: copy of the temporary role we applied:``` 
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: gpu-deployer-temp
  namespace: gpu-namespace
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
- apiGroups: ["authentication.k8s.io"]
  resources: ["tokenreviews"]
  verbs: ["create"]
- apiGroups: ["" ]
  resources: ["serviceaccounts"]
  verbs: ["impersonate"]
```

devon: thanks — please also add the audit annotation to the rollout controller so we can filter the backlog: `audit.k8s.redwood/instrumentation: "deploy-controller-rollback"`

morgan: i'll send a PR to the rbac refactor branch to restore the missing label on infra-deployer clusterrole and add an integration test that validates `kubectl auth can-i` for critical SAs after templating. link: https://git.redwood/infrarbac/merge_requests/432 :+1:

anil: follow-ups: 1) temp role -> revoke after aggregation fix 2) update cluster audit policy to include `impersonate` events, 3) confirm KMS decrypt success metrics, 4) postmortem note + timeline.

sarah: good plan. setting severity to P2 for now since we mitigated, will escalate if any regressions. i'll add the incident note to the ticket and ping compliance for audit retention verification. :thumbsup:

morgan: LGTM. I'll coordinate the PR and rollback window.

devon: if anyone sees other namespaces affected, add them to the ticket. might be a global aggregation gap.

sarah: will scan audit-forwarder logs and report results here tomorrow morning. thanks all.
